sentences.en: They lit a fire and grilled fish on the wood.

sentences.ar: الأكل كان أطيب إشي أكلوه بحياتهم.
sentences.en: The food was the best thing they had eaten in their lives.
They swam and played and slept under the trees.

sentences.ar: ما في حدا يقول لهم روحوا ناموا.
sentences.en: Nobody told them to go to bed.

sentences.ar: بس بالليلة التانية، صار في سكوت.
sentences.en: But on the second night, a silence fell.

sentences.ar: كل واحد فيهم كان يفكر ببيته.
sentences.en: Each of them was thinking about his home.
